actor_id.description:
The acting admin's id, for `password_reset_by_admin`. `None` for
the other two kinds, which are the account acting on itself.

role.description:
Taken as a string and parsed here, so an unknown value is this
server's own `invalid_role` from the closed error set rather than
serde's rejection text.

complete.description:
Always `true`, and always the last field. Missing means the
export was cut off and must be discarded.

format_version.description: Bumped on any change to the document's shape.

code.description: Stable. Branch on this, never on `message`.

message.description: For humans; may be reworded. Never echoes request input.

reason.description:
A code from the closed set in `crate::events::validate`.
Absent unless the status is `rejected`.

truncated.description:
`true` when more events matched the window than this response
carries. The caller narrows the window and asks again; there is
no cursor to resume with - see `events::query` for why.

pairing_code.description:
Grouped for reading aloud: `XXXXX-XXXXX`. Shown once; the
server stores only a hash and cannot show it again.

server_time.description:
So a client can tell a person how long they have without
having to trust its own clock against the server's.

pairing_code.description:
Accepted in any spelling a person might type; normalized in
`crate::devices::code`.

platform.description:
Taken as a string and parsed in the service layer, so an
unknown value becomes this server's own `invalid_platform`
rather than serde's rejection text quoting what was sent.

device_token.description: Returned exactly once. The server keeps only its hash.

other_sessions_ended.description:
How many other sessions of this account were ended. The one that
made the request is not counted, and still works.

invite_token.description: The token handed over by an admin.

setup_token.description: The token printed to stdout at startup.

timezone.description: An IANA name such as `Europe/Berlin`; `UTC` until one is set.

status.description:
`"active"` or `"pending"` - a pending account has not yet
redeemed its invite.

csrf_token.description: The `csrf_token` from login or `GET /api/v1/auth/me`, on every write that requires it - always together with the session cookie.
csrf_token.name: X-CSRF-Token

device_token.description: The device token from `POST /api/v1/pair`. Never a session.
